answer: A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The pigment counter is kept in canyon and relic reveals each reset. An hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The attacker spends 46 dollars and 14 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
